callout.text: Even the highest estimate, 5.5 million barrels a day, covers about a quarter of the pre-war flow. The lowest, 2.6, covers about an eighth.

source: Sources: EIA, Global Energy Security Data (16 Nov 2026) and Today in Energy (2025); IEA, Strait of Hormuz; OilPrice.com. IEA and EIA figures use different definitions and are not directly comparable. Capacity is not the same as what can safely be exported.
